title: I built an AI video editor

overlays.vo: As a corporate nine to five girly, I do not have time to edit my reels while I'm trying to build my personal brand.

overlays.text: So I built an AI video editor
overlays.vo: So I made us an AI video editor and it even edited this reel that you're watching right now.
Let's get started. First, make one folder. I called mine the AI video editor...
...and then inside have three other folders called raw footage,
Then we're going to go ahead and open it up in Claude Code.
Next is the tools. Here's every repo I use. Screenshot this and tell Claude: be my Instagram video editor, install these tools, test each one and tell me when you're ready.
Then teach it your editing style. Give it three to five of your own reels, or ones you're inspired by, and say study these and pull the fonts, colors, captions and pacing into one brand sheet.
Now I drop the rough cut into the raw footage folder and say add title, captions, animations, and show me a storyboard before you export.
This part is super important: it builds this storyboard dashboard and I approve each beat or leave notes on any changes, and send it back for the next draft.
This is the one that everybody asks me about, so I made a full step-by-step guide. Comment editor and I'll send it right to you.
